DESCRIPTION: Shared base rule (every owner). Normalized scam links (lowercase host, no www, no http/https, no trailing slash, tracking query parameters removed; t.me/telegram.me paths lowercased; api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=N -> wa.me/N). An exact Telegram/WhatsApp link match is enough to auto-block; any other watchlisted link auto-blocks together with an existing lure or impersonation feature. An entry without a path matches the whole domain. Entries: domain, url, kind, source, first_seen_handle, added.
